jobs.title: Director General Co-ordination (MP-II Scale)
jobs.description:
Qualification and Experience:
Ph.D. in National Security/Criminology with 05 years professional experience in the field of Defence-Public Sector Logistics Coordination and Right of Way Policy matters
OR
Master's degree in National Security/Criminology with 07 years professional experience in the field of Defence-Public Sector Logistics Coordination and Right of Way Policy matters
Job Location: Place of posting shall be Islamabad with frequent travelling all over the Pakistan Railways.
Job Description:
To monitor ongoing projects in coordination with Logistics Directorate of Army in consultation with respective Director General in the Ministry of Railways.
Joint ventures undertaken by Railways with NLC, FWO, etc., in line with Pakistan Railways policy and instructions of the Secretary/Chairman and Chief Executive Officer/Sr. General Manager.
Military movements through Railways.
All defense related sidings (PAF and Army).
Land issues related to Defense in consultation with Director/P&L, Pakistan Railways, Lahore and Director General Technical in the Ministry of Railways.
Security of CPEC related projects as per policy circulated by Ministry of Railways.
Security of Operations on Bolan Sections (Quetta).
Any other assignment assigned by Secretary/Chairman Railways.
